name: Lv2D-png-to-model
description: 把单张 PNG/JPG 立绘或已分层 PSD 变成可在 VTube Studio 使用的 Live2D 模型：拆层、检查遮挡顺序、路由到 PSD2Live 或半身绑定、通过 MCP 修正绑定缺陷并用渲染图验收。

invocation.unpack: Extract the ZIP and enter the directory containing AI_README.md.

capability_tiers.L0: read the PSD, report layers, sizes and occluders
capability_tiers.L1: key-form and draw-order edits through PSD2Live MCP (no Cubism needed)
capability_tiers.L2: full body rig via PSD2Live CLI/MCP, export moc3/cmo3, install into VTube Studio
capability_tiers.L3: Cubism Editor programmatic editing (requires Cubism 5.4+ integration API; 5.3.x reports SKIP)
capability_tiers.L4: half-body bespoke rig through the bundled rigkit builder

capabilities: See-through result normalization and PSD handling
tk_seethrough workflow generation with opt-in auto-fill and Original base layer
PSD layer naming and front/back occlusion validation
PSD2Live CLI batch conversion to moc3/cmo3
PSD2Live MCP programmatic editing: draw order, keyforms, deformers, render, export
defect diagnosis recipes for mouth, eyes, blink, arms, parameters
VTube Studio model installation and parameter-range tuning
half-body rig generation and VTube Studio installation
full-body PSD quality checklist and PSD2Live routing
limitations: The bundled rigkit builder is fully validated for half-body work; full-body binding requires PSD2Live.
PSD2Live cannot repaint art. A 14 px mouth stays a 14 px mouth; fix the art or accept the artefact.
Layer names drive the binding. Hidden or misnamed mouth/eye layers silently produce a model without that motion.
Exporting through PSD2Live resets Idle/Blink to generated defaults; re-apply tuned motions afterwards.
VTube Studio rewrites <model>.vtube.json on exit, so parameter ranges must be edited while VTS is closed.
Cubism ExternalEdit tools need Cubism 5.4 alpha or newer; the alpha has been discontinued and time-locked, so 5.3.x cannot connect (port 22033 closed).
CObL is trained for multi-object tabletop scenes and is not yet a validated anime occlusion-order judge.
RevealLayer requires bounding boxes and a FLUX.1-dev environment; anime-part quality has not been validated.
Qwen-Image-Layered has about 20.4B BF16 parameters and is not a default 8 GB runtime.
The installer does not upload art or start inference.
Cubism Editor, PSD2Live and VTube Studio require their own licenses and installations.
environment_facts: check_env.py:175 writes a probe file inside the package root; under a restricted sandbox it spins at 100% CPU forever. Run it with unrestricted file access.
PyPI direct connections are reset on some networks; use https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple.
Non-ASCII install paths break Windows argv for wrapped Python calls; install to an ASCII path.
PSD2Live MCP token lives in HKCU\Software\JavaSoft\Prefs\io\github\psd2live\agent, value agent_mcp_bearer_token, strip every '/' (Java prefs encoding).
